acceptance_profile.prospecting_deposits: Represent authored survey/prospecting, deposit/vein/resource, grade, depth/access and discovery definitions with explicit source/provenance and setting/profile scope; unsupported deposit or yield values remain unresolved.

acceptance_profile.world_depletion: Represent authored geology/location, depletion and environmental consequence handoffs through World-Hazard-Action references; DPL-06 must not silently mutate World truth or universalize source depletion formulas.
acceptance_profile.assets_outputs: Reference D17 for tools/equipment and extracted material/ore outputs; no parallel inventory or material ledger and no output creation before owner-domain resolution.
acceptance_profile.facilities_hazards: Reference MIB-14 for extraction facilities/platform capabilities and World-Hazard-Action for cave-in, gas, instability, environmental and other authored hazards; no inferred compatibility or hazard formulas.
acceptance_profile.profession_workforce: Reference DPL-02/Progression and existing Character/social owners for skills, roles and workforce; do not implement DPL-08 staffing/business mechanics.
acceptance_profile.successor_boundary: Raw extraction ends at authored material-output handoff. Refining, smelting, milling, industrial processing, manufacturing and supply chains remain DPL-07.
acceptance_profile.boundaries: No DPL-07+ mechanics, no duplicate Project/World/Asset/facility/material ledger, no universal mining yields/depletion formulas, no real-money commerce and no migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta.
